Dondozo

Water

Paldea · Generation 9

Dondozo is a Water-type Big Catfish Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 12 m tall and weighs 220 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is HP (150), with a base stat total of 530.
